coordinate_contract: Named ROS joint coordinates after SPI sign/offset conversion and subtraction of homing zero. Normal hardware write calls copy_actuator_commands(true); it clamps cmd_pos to these limits when kp>0, then adds the homing zero before the SPI sign/offset transform. Thus these limits apply in the same joint coordinates as policy target_joint_pos, not raw motor coordinates.
relationship_to_controller: All twelve lower bounds are 0.10 rad higher and upper bounds 0.10 rad lower than current MuJoCo/policy-JSON joint limits. This is a second downstream clamp beyond the C++ neural-controller clamp.
scope: Explicit local class-source contract for simulation experiments. Installed Pi URDF, driver, firmware, calibration and active controller are unknown and may differ. No physical limit changes or hardware approval are implied.
